subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Khan Bahadur Ahsanullah was one of the greatest social reformers in the Indian subcontinent. His reformation was mostly in the education sector. He was given the title Khan Bahadur by the British government in recognition of his works. He had a great contribution in the establishment of Dhaka University. He died in 1965. People still regard him as a great saint.
